title: The Odd One Out
statement:
A list of `n` numbers (`n` is odd) contains exactly one number that appears once. Every other number appears exactly twice, in any positions. Print the number that appears once.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains the `n` numbers.

## Output
Print the number that appears once.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16999`, `n` is odd
- `0 <= a_i <= 2^31 - 1`
